assertions.assertion: The service performed is cardiac event monitoring with CPT code 93271.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia as a potential etiology for the transient cerebral ischemic events.
A cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to evaluate for intermittent cardiac abnormalities.
The diagnosis code G45.9 supports the medical necessity of the service.
The diagnosis code R42 supports the medical necessity of the service.
The diagnosis code Z86.73 supports the medical necessity of the service.
